browser_verified.verified_boundary: The article reports that Neandertals share more variants with present-day Eurasians than with sub-Saharan Africans, supporting gene flow into ancestors of non-Africans.
The article reports the 1.9x Denisova genome, a Denisovan sister relationship to Neanderthals, and an estimated 4-6% contribution to present-day Melanesian genomes.
The article identifies Denisova 11 as a first-generation individual with a Neanderthal mother and Denisovan father.

interpretation_rule: Search records are discovery metadata, not results of this project. Report claims retain the population, model, data-quality, and evidentiary boundaries of their cited sources.
